say: artie generate kept the HAL-FORMS walk as a script with no hand edits. Line them up with the HAL Schema Forms script: the same relations, in the same order. The one value the reasoner chose, the smoke counts on the promote, is kept as an object, each count read from the smoke run as the goal's words say, and marked for review. HAL-FORMS says only that the field is text; the goal's own words say what goes in it.
